name: BSP_Math_AbsFloat
evidence: FLD float, FABS, round through float, ST0 return and RET 4. Native fixtures match the C++ semantic port.

name: BSP_Vec3d_CrossReversed
evidence: Output EAX; inputs ECX, EDX. Sequential stores implement b cross a; preserves alias side effects. Native fixtures verified.

name: BSP_Vec3d_SubtractReversed
evidence: Output EAX; inputs ECX, EDX. Three double components of b minus a. Native fixtures verified.

name: BSP_Vec3d_ScaleInPlace
evidence: Vector EAX, stack double factor, RET 8. Native fixtures verified.

name: BSP_Vec3d_LengthSquared
evidence: Vector EAX, x87 ST0 result. Assembly adds y squared plus x squared before z squared. Native fixtures verified.

name: BSP_WinMain
evidence: CRT 00bfd0dd supplies image base, null previous instance, command line and show flags. Both visible returns are RET 10h. COM setup, MidwayThreadMutex, application construction, initialization, platform loop, shutdown.

name: BSP_Application_Construct
evidence: Base 00bea970, vtable 00cfeab0; zeros offsets 08,0c,10,14; flags at 18=1,19=0,1a=0. Stack-owned object in WinMain.

name: BSP_Application_Initialize
evidence: WinMain passes this in ECX and stack arguments 0 and cachedload. Initializes resources, audio, window, Lua datatables and game systems; observed behavior, original class name unknown.

name: BSP_Application_Shutdown
evidence: WinMain calls after platform loop. Releases references, destroys systems, calls XLiveUninitialize and unloads input datatables.

name: BSP_Application_Destruct
evidence: Called on stack application after shutdown. Releases the dynamic reference array at this+08. Earlier decompilation was truncated by incorrect CRT free noreturn annotation.

name: BSP_Platform_RunLoopDispatch
evidence: Loads singleton 0109cf04 into ECX and tail-jumps to virtual slot +24h. Called between application initialize and shutdown; exact loop implementation still to resolve.

name: BSP_CriticalSection_Create
evidence: Allocates 1ch bytes: x86 CRITICAL_SECTION at +0 and signed recursion depth at +18h. Initializes OS lock and depth=0.

name: BSP_CriticalSection_DestroyOwned
evidence: ECX points to lock pointer. Drains positive depth at +18h via LeaveCriticalSection; DeleteCriticalSection then free, followed by owner-pointer clear at 0041ccb6. Shutdown requires owning/quiescent thread. Pointer-clear bytes were undefined under the old free noreturn annotation.

name: BSP_RandomThreads_Initialize
evidence: Creates lock at 01090ac0 and clears ten thread IDs at 01090ac4..01090ae8. Does not reset high-water at 01090aec or seed states.

name: BSP_RandomThreads_RegisterCurrent
evidence: Under tracked lock, fills first free slot of ten with GetCurrentThreadId and increases high-water. No duplicate-ID check; full table silently leaves thread unregistered.

name: BSP_RandomThreads_UnregisterCurrent
evidence: Under tracked lock, clears first matching current thread ID. Shrinks high-water only if that slot was last, scanning trailing holes.

name: BSP_RandomThreads_Shutdown
evidence: Passes address 01090ac0 to tracked critical-section destructor; does not reset IDs or random states.

name: BSP_RandomThreads_GetState
evidence: ECX is stream index. Current thread slot i maps to 01090af0+(2*i+stream)*09c8h; unregistered threads use 00e14748. No lookup lock or stream bounds check.

name: BSP_RandomState_ConstructDefault
evidence: Index=0; bytes +09c4=1, +09c5=0; then seed with 1105h. Static initialization constructs twenty 09c8h states.

name: BSP_RandomState_Seed
evidence: ECX state; stack uint seed, RET 4. state[0]=seed|1; 623 further words multiply preceding word by 69069 modulo 2^32. Index ends at 624. Does not change guard flags.

name: BSP_RandomState_Refill
evidence: 624-word in-place twist, split at 227 and 623, offset 397, upper/lower masks and 9908b0dfh odd-word constant. Final index=0.

name: BSP_RandomState_NextU32
evidence: ECX state. Guard bytes +09c5 && !+09c4 trigger null write. Refill at index>=624, then shifts 11,7,15,18 with observed masks. Returns uint in EAX.

name: BSP_RandomThreads_NextU32
evidence: ECX stream selector; GetState then tail-call NextU32 on returned state.

name: BSP_RandomThreads_Seed
evidence: ECX stream selector, EDX seed. Push seed, resolve current state, invoke RandomState_Seed.

name: BSP_PlatformBase_RegisterSingleton
evidence: Stores this into 0109cf04 under singleton-manager lock; base vtable 00d68604.

name: BSP_PlatformBase_UnregisterSingleton
evidence: Removes singleton from manager under lock and clears 0109cf04; base destruction.

name: BSP_WindowPlatformBase_Construct
evidence: Calls singleton base constructor, initializes window configuration fields including 640x480 and 32-bit depth. Constructor aspect calculation reads old width/height before those stores; do not infer a clean default ratio.

name: BSP_Win32Platform_Construct
evidence: Calls window-platform base constructor and installs vtable 00d68cc4. Initializes HWND at +30h and state bytes +40h..+44h, +170h,+180h,+181h.

name: BSP_Win32Platform_RunLoop
evidence: One PeekMessageA per do-while iteration. XLive pretranslation gates TranslateMessage/DispatchMessage. Empty queue invokes virtual +20h only when byte +42h is set. Tests +181h after each iteration and sets +43h on exit; no explicit WM_QUIT branch.

name: BSP_Win32Platform_CreateWindowAndDevice
evidence: Concrete vtable +4h target recovered as a missing function. Registers CS_GLOBALCLASS class with 24 extra bytes; creates caption/popup window; initializes renderer and changes power/screensaver state. Not yet ported/executed.

name: BSP_Win32Platform_HandleMessage
evidence: Concrete vtable +28h. WM_CREATE stores object in window-extra offset0; handles activation, resize, text input, sizing loop, and close-request byte +180h. Includes unresolved audio/input/UI calls.

name: BSP_Win32Platform_RunFrame
evidence: Calls application object at this+48h virtual +10h, then cursor/focus state updater 00becb20(false).

name: BSP_Win32Platform_DisableFramesAndPostQuit
evidence: Restores saved power scheme when present, clears +42h and calls PostQuitMessage(0). Does not directly set loop-exit flag +181h.

name: BSP_Win32Platform_ApplyWindowMode
evidence: Updates dimensions/aspect/fullscreen flags, changes styles and HWND z-order/position, and foreground/focus. Original APIs and transitions observed; not yet ported.

name: BSP_Win32Platform_UpdateCursorFocusState
evidence: Checks focus and input/UI state, transitions cursor visibility via ShowCursor loops and performs mouse-related reset calls. Exact dependent subsystem meanings remain unresolved.

name: BSP_Application_RunFrame
evidence: Application vtable 00cfeab0 slot +10h, invoked by Win32Platform_RunFrame. Updates time-dependent systems and copies global exit request 00e1ae75 into platform loop-exit byte +181h; other per-frame work is not yet reconstructed.

name: BSP_Win32Platform_WindowProcThunk
evidence: WNDCLASSA.lpfnWndProc in 00becee0. Loads singleton 0109cf04, forwards object plus four WNDPROC stack arguments to vtable +28h; RET 10h. Function recovered from confirmed code target.

name: BSP_D3D9Renderer_Construct
evidence: Called by application initialization 0073da88. Installs primary vtable 00d5f0a8 and secondary 00d5f0a4; calls Direct3DCreate9(32), stores interface at this+1990h. Full constructor not ported.

name: BSP_D3D9Renderer_InitializeDeviceAndResources
evidence: Renderer vtable 00d5f0a8 slot +4h, thiscall RET 28h. Builds 56-byte presentation parameters at +1a28h, gets HAL caps, creates device at +1a10h using MULTITHREADED plus HW VP iff HW T&L and shader low word >=0101h; otherwise SW VP. CreateDevice initially receives Windowed=TRUE; only afterward stored Windowed becomes !fullscreen. Later initializes render state and dynamic vertex/index buffers. Only device-creation prefix currently ported.

name: BSP_D3D9Renderer_SetRenderStateCached
evidence: thiscall RET 8h. Valid byte at this+40h+state, value at this+114h+4*state. Writes cache before device virtual E4h SetRenderState, increments +1ba0h even on API failure; skips unchanged valid entries. Optional renderer guard.

name: BSP_D3D9Renderer_SetSamplerStateCached
evidence: thiscall RET Ch. Twenty internal sampler banks; samplers >=16 map to API sampler+F1h (vertex samplers 257..260). Cache validity at +11cch+72*sampler+state, DWORD value at +11dch+72*sampler+4*state. Device virtual 114h SetSamplerState; counter +1ba4h; cache updated even on failure.

name: BSP_D3D9Renderer_InitializeDefaultStates
evidence: thiscall no stack args. Calls cached setter for 19 ordered render states, then seven sampler defaults on each of twenty banks. Defaults include ZFUNC LESS, CULL CCW, linear min/mag, point mip and wrap UVW. Invoked at startup and after successful device reset.

name: BSP_Renderer_EnterOptionalGuard
evidence: Increments non-atomic global nesting 0108d6e0; if mode 0108d6dc enabled and this+4 lock nonnull, enters tracked critical section and increments depth+18h, returns true; otherwise false.

name: BSP_Renderer_LeaveOptionalGuard
evidence: thiscall RET 4h; ignores saved enter-result stack argument. Decrements nesting 0108d6e0, conditionally decrements depth/leaves this+4 lock using CURRENT mode 0108d6dc, and when nesting zero copies mode to observed byte 0108d6dd. Concurrent mode transitions not validated.

name: BSP_D3D9Renderer_SetStreamFrequencyCached
evidence: thiscall RET 8h. Compares stream cache DWORD this+1780h+16*stream, updates on change, calls device virtual 198h SetStreamSourceFreq(stream,value), with optional renderer guard.

name: BSP_D3D9Renderer_ProcessDeviceReset
evidence: Checks render thread ID and global pending/lost flags 0108d4b8/b9. TestCooperativeLevel handles DEVICELOST/DEVICENOTRESET; requires active focused platform window, releases state/resources, calls device Reset with stored presentation parameters, restores resources/default states on success. Dependencies not yet ported.

name: BSP_D3D9Surface_InitializeBinding
evidence: thiscall RET 4h. Stores surface at +2ch without releasing prior pointer, AddRefs nonnull input, GetDesc copies Format to +18h, Width/Height to +1ch/+20h and MultiSampleType to +24h; leaves +28h unchanged. Null clears +18h..28h. Assembly resolves corrupt pseudocode stack locals. Constructor-use helper, not replacement assignment.

name: BSP_D3D9Renderer_CaptureDefaultSurfaces
evidence: Gets render target 0 and depth surface; constructs 34h surface wrappers via 00b3f630(surface,0,0), installs intrusive references at +197ch/+198ch, releases temporary wrapper/getter references, then binds depth via 00b21690. Assembly confirms COM ownership despite broken decompiler stack tracking. Full routine not ported.

name: BSP_D3D9Surface_Construct
evidence: 34h wrapper with intrusive count +4h=1, vtable 00d619a0; calls surface initialize helper 00b3cc80, diagnostic singleton 00b3e730 and adjusts tracking global when flags 10h/100h set. Full constructor not ported.

name: BSP_D3D9VertexBuffer_Construct
evidence: 2ch wrapper initialized with intrusive count1, remaining fields zero, final vtable 00d61e7c. Used before CreateVertexBuffer in renderer initialization.

name: BSP_D3D9IndexBuffer_Construct
evidence: 2ch wrapper initialized with intrusive count1, remaining fields zero, final vtable 00d61e58. Used before CreateIndexBuffer in renderer initialization.

name: BSP_D3D9VertexBuffer_Attach
evidence: thiscall RET Ch. Stores metadata arguments at +14h/+18h; replaces +28h COM pointer by AddRef new before Release old when distinct; also constructs diagnostic strings and calls singleton 00b3e730. Engine registry integration not ported.

name: BSP_D3D9IndexBuffer_Attach
evidence: thiscall RET Ch. Stores metadata arguments at +14h/+18h; replaces +28h COM pointer by AddRef new before Release old when distinct; also constructs diagnostic strings and calls singleton 00b3e730. Engine registry integration not ported.

name: BSP_D3D9VertexBuffer_Destruct
evidence: Calls singleton 00b3e730, releases and clears COM buffer +28h, then base destructor 00b4b530. Full registry/base cleanup not ported.

name: BSP_D3D9IndexBuffer_Destruct
evidence: Calls singleton 00b3e730, releases and clears COM buffer +28h, then base destructor 00b4b490. Full registry/base cleanup not ported.

name: BSP_D3D9Renderer_BindDepthSurface
evidence: Optional renderer guard around device virtual 9ch SetDepthStencilSurface; null wrapper binds null, otherwise uses surface at wrapper+2ch and increments counter this+1bcch. Not yet ported.

name: BSP_D3D9Surface_ReleaseForReset
evidence: Surface vtable +3ch. Balanced AddRef/Release pair then releases and nulls +2ch, preserving dimensions/format/multisample and depth flag for recreation.

name: BSP_D3D9Surface_RecreateAfterReset
evidence: Recovered missing vtable +40h target; thiscall RET 4h. Flag +30h selects CreateDepthStencilSurface(discard=true) vs CreateRenderTarget(lockable=false). Uses saved width/height/format/multisample, quality0, null shared handle, output+2ch. Original ignores HRESULT.

name: BSP_D3D9Renderer_ReleaseDynamicBuffersForReset
evidence: Optional guard. If +1d8ch enabled, clears flag, releases and nulls COM pointers +28h in wrappers at renderer+1974h/+1978h, vertex before index. Wrapper objects survive.

name: BSP_D3D9Renderer_ReleaseResourcesForReset
evidence: Optional guard, enabled byte+1d8bh. Unbinds textures/streams/index via virtual calls; invokes surface release +3ch and other registered resource callbacks; finally clears cache subobject at this+34h using 00b241c0. Full dependency graph not ported.

name: BSP_D3D9Renderer_RestoreResourcesAfterReset
evidence: Runs when resources not ready (+1d8bh=0) and device not marked lost (+1d8ah=0). Reacquires default render/depth surfaces through GetRenderTarget/GetDepthStencilSurface and wrapper+14h initialize; invokes registered restore callbacks, including surface+40h recreation. Not yet ported.

name: BSP_D3D9Renderer_ClearBindingCache
evidence: Receives cache subobject at renderer+34h, not renderer base. Releases intrusive references, clears 210 render-valid bytes, twenty sampler-valid banks and other binding caches. Full cache layout and port remain incomplete.

name: BSP_D3D9VertexBuffer_Recreate
evidence: thiscall RET4. Decodes wrapper flags+14h into pool and usage; pool0 implies WRITEONLY, dynamic nibble1000h adds DYNAMIC. Creates capacity+18h FVF0 buffer, retains new before releasing old +28h, drops temporary reference. Invalid pool nibble>3 uses device pointer as pool in native assembly; new interface rejects it.

name: BSP_D3D9IndexBuffer_Recreate
evidence: Same metadata decoding and COM replacement sequence as vertex 00b492b0, but CreateIndexBuffer with INDEX16. New interface returns HRESULT and preserves old binding on failure; original ignores failures.

name: BSP_D3D9VertexBuffer_Lock
evidence: thiscall RET14h: bytes, extra offset, unused DWORD, output base offset pointer, read-only byte. Dynamic flag1000h selects DISCARD when cursor0 else NOOVERWRITE, advances cursor and counters even on API failure. Non-dynamic uses NOSYSLOCK plus optional READONLY. Null buffer returns sentinel00f8d4b8; diagnostic conditions call singleton004c14c0. Only nonnull non-diagnostic path ported.

name: BSP_D3D9IndexBuffer_Lock
evidence: Same lock metadata/flags and five stack args as vertex00b4ba00, targeting index COM buffer. Dynamic read-only flag is ignored, output offset excludes extra offset. Null-buffer sentinel and singleton diagnostic branches remain unported.

name: BSP_D3D9VertexBuffer_Unlock
evidence: If COM pointer+28h nonnull, calls virtual30h Unlock and decrements depth+20h even on failure. Null pointer leaves depth unchanged.

name: BSP_D3D9IndexBuffer_Unlock
evidence: If COM pointer+28h nonnull, calls virtual30h Unlock and decrements depth+20h even on failure. Null pointer leaves depth unchanged.

name: BSP_D3D9Renderer_RestoreDynamicBuffers
evidence: If dynamic-ready+1d8ch false and device-lost+1d8ah false, sets ready then invokes vertex/index wrapper virtual20h recreation with renderer device+1a10h. Full renderer orchestration not ported.

name: BSP_D3D9Renderer_BindVertexStream
evidence: Vtable+134h. Caches logical stream object and intrusive ref; compares underlying COM buffer, stride from declaration+cc and offset to skip redundant SetStreamSource. Same logical object returns early. Device slot190h, counter+1bb4h. Wrapper-based path not yet ported. Update: semantic binding/draw projection now ported with shared logical ownership and diagnostic indexed pixel readback; native constructors, registry and ABI remain incomplete.

name: BSP_D3D9Renderer_BindIndexStream
evidence: Recovered vtable+138h. Always writes base vertex+17bch; only changes SetIndices when logical index wrapper+17b8h changes, managing intrusive ref and obtaining COM pointer through wrapper+28h. Counter+1bb8h. Not ported. Update: semantic binding/draw projection now ported with shared logical ownership and diagnostic indexed pixel readback; native constructors, registry and ABI remain incomplete.

name: BSP_D3D9Renderer_DrawIndexedPrimitive
evidence: Recovered vtable+13ch, RET14h. Gated by inhibit+1d90h/lost+1d8ah and nonzero vertex/primitive counts; special stream0 tag40000001h rejects requested vertices beyond stream count. Calls DrawIndexedPrimitive with stored base vertex+17bch, optional guard. Logical stream gate remains unported. Update: semantic binding/draw projection now ported with shared logical ownership and diagnostic indexed pixel readback; native constructors, registry and ABI remain incomplete.

name: BSP_D3D9Renderer_DrawPrimitive
evidence: Recovered vtable+140h, RETCh. Skips inhibit+1d90h, device-lost+1d8ah or zero primitive count; optional guard then device slot144h DrawPrimitive. Helper00b1f740 called on object+1904h only computes unused ECX+10h (LEA/RET), no observable side effects. New interface returns HRESULT/S_FALSE.

name: BSP_D3D9Renderer_CopyRenderTargetToOpaqueSurface
evidence: Recovered vtable+110h. Nonempty argument triggers surface allocation, D3DXLoadSurfaceFromSurface from current render target, LockRect alpha bits OR ff000000, then output helper00b5e490. Exact output format/API and pitch behavior need assembly review; not ported.

name: BSP_D3D9LogicalVertexStream_Construct
evidence: Factory00b287c0 allocates logical vertex stream, installs vtable00d61d6c. Dynamic path references shared renderer vertex buffer at stream+58h, declaration+68h, offset+5ch and count+64h. Full constructor/registry and allocation paths unported.

name: BSP_D3D9LogicalIndexStream_Construct
evidence: Factory00b288b0 allocates logical index stream, installs vtable00d61de0. Physical buffer wrapper at+8h. Flags choose pool/usage, input format chooses 16/32-bit element size. Full constructor unported.

name: BSP_D3D9LogicalVertexStream_GetVertexCount
evidence: Recovered vtable+20h getter; MOV EAX,[ECX+64h]; RET. Used in indexed-draw stream0 limit gate.

name: BSP_D3D9LogicalVertexStream_GetDeclaration
evidence: Recovered vtable+24h getter; returns stream+68h pointer. Vertex binding reads declaration stride at+ cch.

name: BSP_D3D9LogicalVertexStream_GetByteOffset
evidence: Recovered vtable+28h getter; returns DWORD stream+5ch, passed as SetStreamSource offset.

name: BSP_D3D9LogicalVertexStream_GetBuffer
evidence: Recovered vtable+2ch; loads physical wrapper stream+58h then tailcalls wrapper+1ch. Concrete physical getter00b4b9f0 bytes8b4128c3 returns COM buffer+28h.

name: BSP_D3D9LogicalIndexStream_GetBuffer
evidence: Recovered vtable+28h; loads physical wrapper stream+8h then tailcalls wrapper+1ch. Concrete physical getter00b4b840 bytes8b4128c3 returns COM buffer+28h.

name: BSP_VertexDeclaration_AppendElement
evidence: thiscall RETCh, args type/usage/offset. Creates20-byte record {offset,type,0,usage,-1}, default offset uses packed cursor+8h; always adds type size to cursor even with explicit offset. Appends to flat array+ch and usage array+18h+12*usage, recomputes stride.

name: BSP_VertexDeclaration_RecomputeStride
evidence: Clears+ cch and sums table00d61cc0[type] for flat20-byte records. Stride is sum of element sizes, not maximum offset plus size.

name: BSP_VertexDeclaration_HasSemantic
evidence: Scans flat records by usage field+ch and occurrence. Only AL is boolean; upper EAX bits are incidental loop count. New C++ interface returns bool.

name: BSP_VertexDeclaration_FindSemantic
evidence: Scans flat records by usage and occurrence, returns flat index or -1.

name: BSP_VertexDeclaration_GetSemanticOffset
evidence: Per-usage array at+18h+12*usage,20-byte element index, returns DWORD0 offset.

name: BSP_VertexDeclaration_GetSemanticType
evidence: Same per-usage array lookup, returns DWORD1 type.

name: BSP_VertexDeclaration_GetSemanticSize
evidence: Returns type-size table00d61cc0 entry for per-usage record type. Table17 DWORDs matches D3D declaration data-type byte sizes.

name: BSP_LogicalVertexStreamBase_Construct
evidence: Initializes intrusive refcount, monotonically increasing ID0108fee0, default tag40000000h, stride from declaration+cch and selected usage metadata via semantic lookup helpers. Full native constructor not yet ported.
